author: sjm41
body:
* **PTHR ID & PTN node:**
PTN000828201 (PTHR10513)

* **Sequences with problematic annotation (ID + gene/protein name):**
Fly ND-42 (FBgn0019957)
human NDUFA10 (O95299)

* **Type of Issue: Erroneous source or erroneous propagation, or other issue**
PTN000828201 adds ''[NADH dehydrogenase (ubiquinone) activity](https://staging2026_01.flybase.org/reports/GO:0008137)" to members of the [DEOXYNUCLEOSIDE KINASE (PTHR10513)](http://www.pantherdb.org/panther/family.do?clsAccession=PTHR10513) family.
This is based on:
MOUSE|MGI=MGI=1914523|UniProtKB=Q99LC3

however, as the Q99LC3/O95299 page says, this is an "Accessory subunit of the mitochondrial membrane respiratory chain NADH dehydrogenase (Complex I), that is believed not to be involved in catalysis."

So can you remove this MF please?
title: PAINT issue: PTN000828201 (PTHR10513)
